neck:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single square 1024x1024 main service illustration for the existing Hexiaoyue mobile menu.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY STYLE MASTER (the airy white-background SPA mascot illustration). Input image 2 is the SECONDARY MASCOT / LINE QUALITY reference. Input image 3 is the CURRENT PROJECT IMAGE whose service subject must be preserved but whose heavy yellow room scenery and elongated character must be replaced.
Create a polished sibling in exactly the illustration family of images 1 and 2: hand drawn fine dark olive-brown outlines, flat soft watercolor washes with very subtle paper grain, clean near-white background, muted pale sage green, soft ivory clothing, light natural wood, warm peach blush. Light and airy, friendly neighborhood wellness, no yellow/sepia overlay. Maintain ample clean white breathing space at all four edges (roughly 12-15 percent) and a soft faint sage wash dissolving into white under the scene. No complete room, no wall, no floorboards, no window lattice, no hard rectangular colored background, no vignette.
Preserve the SAME recognizable mascot as references 1 and 2: slightly chubby and adorable, round soft cheeks, simple black oval eyes, chestnut short hair, disproportionately large round head, short rounded limbs and torso, ivory wrap top edged/tied in sage green, loose green pants and brown soft shoes. Lotus LEAF hat must be a broad natural wavy leaf with readable veins and one SHORT gently curved stem of MODERATE thickness (neither chunky sausage nor hair-thin sprout). Keep mascot compact, around 2.5 head heights overall, never an elongated slim adult. Maintain modest and anatomically understandable patient, hand and furniture shapes. No 3D, no photorealism, no glossy plastic, no heavy decorative texture. No titles, no text, no labels, no prices, no explanatory circles, no watermark.
Maintain the narrative service subject from image 3, with only the essential service furniture and a small quiet sage-green unlettered care kit box, two small amber bottles and one rolled ivory towel as secondary props. The props must not dominate. The illustration must remain clear and gentle at thumbnail size. All arms must connect to the correct person, exactly two hands per person, no fused hands, no extra limbs, no dislocated shoulders, no unsupported body. A tasteful coherent finished composition, not a comparison sheet.
Scene: shoulder and neck relaxation. One adult illustrated female customer wears an ivory short-sleeved top and sage trousers, sits comfortably upright on a simple pale wooden chair angled three-quarter view. Her shoulders are level and natural, arms rest in her lap. The chubby lotus-hat mascot stands behind and slightly to the side and gently places one clearly separate hand on each upper shoulder, with two readable continuous forearms coming from his sleeves. The entire small chair, customer's feet and mascot's complete hat are inside the square, uncropped. Keep adult customer simplified and subordinate to the mascot's rounded visual language. A tiny leaf accent and small care tray balance the scene; clean white space surrounds it. It must match the companion waist image's line weight, white background and sage wash.
